Class CallBackImplementation

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.RMI.CallBackImplementation
All Implemented Interfaces:
CallBack, Serializable, Remote
public class CallBackImplementation extends UnicastRemoteObject implements CallBack
Implementation of the CallBack remote interface. This class acts as the bridge between the RMI server and the local ClientController. It receives remote calls from the server and forwards them to the appropriate client-side logic, updating the view or state.

    • showLeaderboard

      public void showLeaderboard(List<GameResult> leaderboard, int myPosition) throws RemoteException
      Shows the final leaderboard to the client at the end of a game session. This method is invoked only when the server database is active, and the leaderboard reflects both players from the finished match and the global database ranking.
